name: Granite State Comicon
blurb: New Hampshire's comic book and pop-culture festival, held at the SNHU Arena and DoubleTree by Hilton in Manchester with a Friday night preview.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'The New Hampshire Comic Book and Pop Culture Festival September 18th-19th, 2027 Friday Night Preview • Sept. 17th SNHU Arena and DoubleTree by Hilton, Manchester NH'

notes: The site relaunched days ago ('New Website Live' Sept 29, 2026, and a 'Granitecon 2026' recap Sept 25, 2026, both referring to the just-finished prior edition). Its /celebrities, /artists and /guests pages (the last two redirect/alias to the same near-empty templates) show no real guest cards yet — one even still links a Squarespace 'construction.png' placeholder graphic — consistent with no guests announced yet for Sept 2027. The batch note said SNHU Arena is a 'secondary' venue (implying DoubleTree by Hilton is the main one), which this pass could not independently confirm; the site's own text names SNHU Arena first ('SNHU Arena and DoubleTree by Hilton, Manchester NH') without clarifying roles, so SNHU Arena (a full arena, plausible as the main exhibit hall) was recorded as venue — worth a human double-check. Organizer taken from the footer copyright line ('Granite State Comicon, LLC'). 2026-10-08: re-checked, /celebrities shows only a TBA placeholder tile ('First Last'), no guests, so still none-yet.
